#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <iomanip>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Edge {
    int to, flow, rev, cost;
    Edge(int t, int f, int c, int r) : to(t), flow(f), cost(c), rev(r) {}
};

class NetworkFlow {
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<vector<Edge>> mat;
    vector<int> dist;
    int V, src, sink, maxFlow;
    ll minCost;
    const ll INF = (ll)1e15;

    NetworkFlow(int nodes, int s, int t) {
        V = nodes; src = s; sink = t;
        maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
        graph.resize(V);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        Edge fwd(v, cap, cost, graph[v].size());
        Edge bkw(u, 0, -cost, graph[u].size());
        graph[u].push_back(fwd);
        graph[v].push_back(bkw);
    }

    void finalizeGraph() {
        mat.resize(V);
        for(int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
            mat[i] = graph[i];
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool bellmanFord(bool check) {
        dist.assign(V, INT_MAX / 2);
        dist[src] = 0;
        for(int iter = 0; iter < V - 1; iter++) {
            bool updated = false;
            for(int u = 0; u < V; u++) {
                if(dist[u] == INT_MAX/2) continue;
                for(Edge& e : mat[u]) {
                    if(e.flow > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(!updated) break;
        }
        if(check) {
            for(int u = 0; u < V; u++) {
                if(dist[u] == INT_MAX/2) continue;
                for(Edge& e : mat[u]) {
                    if(e.flow > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<int> parNode, parEdge, visited, distSpfa;
    vector<int> queueSpfa;

    bool spfa() {
        distSpfa.assign(V, INT_MAX/2);
        parNode.assign(V, -1);
        parEdge.assign(V, -1);
        visited.assign(V, 0);
        queueSpfa.resize(V);
        distSpfa[src] = 0;
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        queueSpfa[tail++] = src;
        while(head != tail) {
            int u = queueSpfa[head++];
            if(head == V) head = 0;
            visited[u] = 2;
            for(int i = 0; i < mat[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = mat[u][i];
                if(e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = distSpfa[u] + e.cost;
                if(nd < distSpfa[e.to]) {
                    if(visited[e.to] == 0) {
                        queueSpfa[tail++] = e.to;
                        if(tail == V) tail = 0;
                    } else if(visited[e.to] == 2) {
                        if(--head == -1) head += V;
                        queueSpfa[head] = e.to;
                    }
                    visited[e.to] = 1;
                    parEdge[e.to] = i;
                    parNode[e.to] = u;
                    distSpfa[e.to] = nd;
                }
            }
        }
        return visited[sink] != 0;
    }

    struct NodeDist {
        int node, dist;
        NodeDist(int n, int d) : node(n), dist(d) {}
        bool operator<(const NodeDist& o) const {
            return dist > o.dist;
        }
    };

    bool dijkstra() {
        visited.assign(V, 0);
        distSpfa.assign(V, INT_MAX/2);
        parNode.assign(V, -1);
        parEdge.assign(V, -1);
        fill(distSpfa.begin(), distSpfa.end(), INT_MAX/2);
        distSpfa[src] = 0;
        priority_queue<NodeDist> pq;
        pq.push(NodeDist(src, 0));
        while(!pq.empty()) {
            NodeDist cur = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            while(distSpfa[cur.node] < cur.dist) {
                if(pq.empty()) return false;
                cur = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
            }
            visited[cur.node] = 2;
            for(int i = 0; i < mat[cur.node].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = mat[cur.node][i];
                if(e.flow == 0) continue;
                int redCost = e.cost + distSpfa[cur.node] - distSpfa[e.to];
                int nd = cur.dist + redCost;
                if(nd < distSpfa[e.to]) {
                    if(visited[e.to] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push(NodeDist(e.to, nd));
                    distSpfa[e.to] = nd;
                    parNode[e.to] = cur.node;
                    parEdge[e.to] = i;
                    visited[e.to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visited[sink] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        int v = sink;
        while(v != src) {
            int u = parNode[v], idx = parEdge[v];
            flow = min(flow, mat[u][idx].flow);
            v = u;
        }
        v = sink;
        while(v != src) {
            int u = parNode[v], idx = parEdge[v];
            mat[u][idx].flow -= flow;
            mat[v][mat[u][idx].rev].flow += flow;
            v = u;
        }
        maxFlow += flow;
        return flow;
    }

    void computeFlow() {
        bellmanFord(false);
        while(spfa()) {
            if(distSpfa[sink] >= INT_MAX/2 - 1) break;
            minCost += distSpfa[sink] * augment();
        }
    }

    void computeFlowWithPotential() {
        bellmanFord(false);
        while(dijkstra()) {
            ll m = distSpfa[sink] + distSpfa[sink] - distSpfa[src];
            if(m >= INT_MAX/2LL) break;
            minCost += m * augment();
            for(int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                if(visited[i] != 0) {
                    distSpfa[i] += distSpfa[i] - distSpfa[src];
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

class Task {
public:
    void run(int test, istream& in, ostream& out) {
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        int maxLayers = n + k;
        int terminal = n * maxLayers + 1;
        NetworkFlow net(terminal + 1, 0, terminal);
        vector<int> freq(n + 1, 0), items(k + 1);
        for(int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            in >> items[i];
            freq[items[i]]++;
        }
        for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if(freq[i] > 0)
                net.addEdge(0, i, freq[i], 0);
        }
        for(int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for(int layer = 0; layer < maxLayers - 1; layer++) {
                net.addEdge(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        for(int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int u, v;
            in >> u >> v;
            for(int layer = 0; layer < maxLayers - 1; layer++) {
                for(int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    if(u != 1)
                        net.addEdge(layer * n + u, (layer + 1) * n + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    if(v != 1)
                        net.addEdge(layer * n + v, (layer + 1) * n + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                }
            }
        }
        for(int layer = 1; layer < maxLayers; layer++) {
            net.addEdge(layer * n + 1, terminal, k, 0);
        }
        net.finalizeGraph();
        net.computeFlowWithPotential();
        if(net.maxFlow != k)
            out << "BUG" << endl;
        else
            out << net.minCost << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    istream& in = cin;
    ostream& out = cout;
    Task runner;
    runner.run(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
